teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel kliem jew sinjali fuq karta jew fuq skrin.

formal.en: The student wrote a report about the environment.
formal.zh: 学生写了一份关于环境的报告。

colloquial.en: — Who wrote this? — I did.
colloquial.zh: — 这是谁写的？— 我写的。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kiteb 的“写”与 ktieb 的“书”成对记，别混淆动词和名词。

sense_translations.en_definition: to name sb. as the heir of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指定某人为某物的继承人

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' paġni b'test jew stampi biex taqrahom.

formal.mt: Dan il-ktieb jispjega l-istorja ta' Malta.
formal.en: This book explains the history of Malta.
formal.zh: 这本书讲述马耳他的历史。

colloquial.en: — Where is the book? — On the table.
colloquial.zh: — 书在哪里？— 在桌上。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本写满字的书：ktieb 是书，kiteb 是写。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn l-istudenti jitgħallmu mal-għalliema.

formal.en: The school offers Maltese courses.
formal.zh: 学校开设马耳他语课程。

colloquial.en: — Where is the school? — Near the church.
colloquial.zh: — 学校在哪里？— 在教堂旁边。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skola 和复数 skejjel 成对记；加冠词时读写 l-iskola。

sense_translations.en_definition: school (an institution dedicated to teaching and learning)
school (the followers of a particular doctrine)
school (a department/institute at a college or university)

teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istilla li tagħti d-dawl u s-sħana lid-dinja.

formal.en: The sun is a source of energy.

colloquial.en: — Is it sunny today? — Yes.
colloquial.zh: — 今天有太阳吗？— 有。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“阳光”dawl ix-xemx 记词，x 的声音像英语 sh。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu li nixorbu u nużaw biex naħslu.

formal.en: Drinking water should be clean.

colloquial.en: — Would you like some water? — Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: — 要喝点水吗？— 好的，谢谢。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ilma 放进一杯水的画面；冠词形式 l-ilma。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini fejn jgħixu n-nies.

formal.en: The house is in a quiet street.
formal.zh: 房屋坐落在一条安静的街道上。

colloquial.en: — Is this your house? — Yes.
colloquial.zh: — 这是你的房子吗？— 是。

cognitive_memory_aid: 房子 dar 与转向 dar 同形；看名词或动词标签再选义。

sense_translations.en_definition: to take a tour of a place
to turn; to veer; to change direction
to wander; to walk about; to travel

teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organu li bih naraw.

formal.en: The doctor examined the patient’s eye.
formal.zh: 医生检查了病人的眼睛。

colloquial.en: — Does your eye hurt? — Yes, a little.
colloquial.zh: — 你的眼睛疼吗？— 是，有一点。

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记眼睛；泉眼是另一个义项。għ 是一个双字母字素。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶眼；被认为能致祸的目光

sense_translations.en_definition: The name of the Latin script letter Għ/għ.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉丁字母组合 Għ／għ 的名称

teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organu li jippompja d-demm fil-ġisem.

formal.en: The heart pumps blood.

colloquial.mt: — Kif qed tħossok? — Għandi qalbi tħabbat ħafna.
colloquial.en: — How are you feeling? — My heart is beating fast.
colloquial.zh: — 你感觉怎么样？— 我的心跳很快。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把心脏与善良的心连起来记；介词 qalb 则表示在……之中。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn għaġina moħmija.

formal.en: Bread is sold in the village shop.

colloquial.en: — Would you like a piece of bread? — Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: — 要一块面包吗？— 好的，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.en: Would you like a piece of bread?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“新鲜面包”ħobż frisk 的早餐画面记住 ħobż。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda kbira ta' ilma mielaħ.

formal.mt: Il-baħar madwar Malta huwa importanti għall-ekonomija.
formal.en: The sea around Malta is important for the economy.
formal.zh: 马耳他周围的海域对经济很重要。

colloquial.en: — Shall we go by the sea? — Yes!
colloquial.zh: — 我们去海边好吗？— 好！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.en: Shall we go by the sea?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马耳他岛边的海；baħar 是海，ilma baħar 是海水。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tul li fih iseħħu l-ġrajjiet.

formal.en: This process takes time.

colloquial.en: — Do you have time? — Only a little.
colloquial.zh: — 你有时间吗？— 只有一点。

cognitive_memory_aid: 从 ftit żmien 到 żmien twil，记住时间长短；冠词不加增音 i。

sense_translations.en_definition: period, age (particular period of time in history)

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna, membru tal-ispeċi umana.

formal.en: Every human being has a right to education.
formal.zh: 每个人都有受教育的权利。

colloquial.mt: — Min hu dak il-bniedem? — Il-ġar tiegħi.
colloquial.en: — Who is that person? — My neighbour.
colloquial.zh: — 那个人是谁？— 我的邻居。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“每个人”和“人权”两个短语记 bniedem。

sense_translations.en_definition: human, human being, man (male or unspecified sex)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 人；人类；男性或性别未指明的人

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità tal-lingwa li għandha tifsira.

formal.en: This word has several meanings.

colloquial.mt: — Xi tfisser din il-kelma? — Ejja nfittxuha.
colloquial.en: — What does this word mean? — Let’s look it up.
colloquial.zh: — 这个词是什么意思？— 我们查一下吧。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一张单词卡当成 kelma；它也能表示说出的话或承诺。

sense_translations.en_definition: an exchange between two or more people

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post minn fejn jgħaddu n-nies jew il-vetturi.

formal.en: The road will be closed to traffic.
formal.zh: 这条路将禁止车辆通行。

colloquial.mt: — Liema triq nieħu? — Dik fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: — Which road should I take? — The one on the left.
colloquial.zh: — 我该走哪条路？— 左边那条。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象路标：triq 是路，加冠词 it-triq，不插入 i。

sense_translations.en_definition: street, road, way (any trail of some width for the movement of pedestrians or wheeled vehicles)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 街道；道路；供行人或车辆通行的路

sense_translations.en_definition: way, route (set of directions that one follows)

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post kbir fejn jgħixu u jaħdmu ħafna nies.

formal.en: The city has a long history.

colloquial.en: — Are you going to town? — Yes, this morning.
colloquial.zh: — 你要进城吗？— 是的，今天上午去。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belt 放在市中心的地图上记。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġenitur mara ta' wild.

formal.en: The mother accompanied her daughter to school.

colloquial.en: — Where is your mother? — At home.
colloquial.zh: — 你母亲在哪里？— 在家。

cognitive_memory_aid: 母亲 omm 与父亲 missier 成对记；称“你母亲”是 ommok。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġenitur raġel ta' wild.

formal.en: The father attended the meeting.

colloquial.en: — Is that your father? — Yes.
colloquial.zh: — 那是你父亲吗？— 是。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 missier 与 omm 放在家庭照片里记。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tafha u li tħobb tqatta' l-ħin magħha.

formal.en: A friend of mine took part in the project.
formal.zh: 我的一位朋友参与了这个项目。

colloquial.en: — Who is coming with you? — A friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: — 谁跟你一起来？— 我的一个朋友。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想起一位老朋友：ħabib antik。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li nużaw biex nuru radd il-ħajr.

formal.en: Thank you for your participation.

colloquial.en: — Here is the coffee. — Thank you!
colloquial.zh: — 咖啡来了。— 谢谢！

cognitive_memory_aid: 收到帮助就说 grazzi；加 ħafna 表示非常感谢。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li ngħidu filgħodu.

formal.mt: Bongu lil kull min qed jattendi din il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Good morning to everyone attending this meeting.
formal.zh: 参加本次会议的各位，早上好。

colloquial.en: — Good morning! — Good morning, how are you?
colloquial.zh: — 早上好！— 早上好，你好吗？

cognitive_memory_aid: 把早晨见面和 bongu 绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li biha nagħtu tweġiba pożittiva.

formal.en: The answer to the question is yes.
formal.zh: 这个问题的答案是肯定的。

colloquial.en: — Would you like tea? — Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: — 想喝茶吗？— 好的，谢谢。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iva 与 le 成对记：肯定与否定。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li biha nagħtu tweġiba negattiva.

formal.en: The answer to the proposal was no.
formal.zh: 这项提议得到的答复是否定的。

colloquial.en: — Would you like coffee? — No, thank you.
colloquial.zh: — 想喝咖啡吗？— 不用，谢谢。

cognitive_memory_aid: 拒绝时说 le, grazzi，意思是不用，谢谢。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Turi li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tinsab ma' persuna jew fil-post tagħha.

formal.en: The document is with the director.

colloquial.mt: — Għand min sejjer? — Għand ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: — Who are you going to see? — A friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: — 你要去谁那里？— 去我朋友那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.en: Who are you going to see?

cognitive_memory_aid: għand 先记“在某人那里”；għandi 表“我有”，须整形记。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jgħid x'kien jew fejn kien xi ħadd fil-passat.

formal.en: The building was a school.
formal.zh: 这栋建筑过去是一所学校。

colloquial.en: — Where was Mark? — At home.
colloquial.zh: — 马克刚才在哪里？— 在家。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kien 记作过去的“是”；kien hemm 是“曾经有”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wettaq azzjoni jew ħoloq xi ħaġa.

formal.en: The team carried out a study about water.
formal.zh: 团队开展了一项关于水的研究。

colloquial.en: — What did he do today? — He wrote a report.
colloquial.zh: — 他今天做了什么？— 写了一份报告。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“做研究、做工作”两个搭配记 għamel。

sense_translations.en_definition: to do a favour or wrong

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa.

formal.en: The course lasts one day.

colloquial.en: — How long will you stay? — One day.
colloquial.zh: — 你会待多久？— 一天。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一天”的画面记 jum，再连读“kull jum”。

sense_translations.en_definition: day (period when a person is awake and experiences things)

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin bejn filgħaxija u filgħodu meta jkun dlam.

formal.en: The workers continued working during the night.

colloquial.en: — How was the night? — Very quiet.
colloquial.zh: — 昨晚怎么样？— 很安静。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“安静的夜晚”的画面记 lejl，再连读“nofs il-lejl”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġisem fit-tarf tad-driegħ li biha naqbdu l-affarijiet.

formal.en: The patient injured his right hand.

colloquial.en: — Which hand hurts? — The left one.
colloquial.zh: — 你哪只手疼？— 左手。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“右手”的画面记 id，再连读“id ix-xellug”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem fejn jinsab il-moħħ.

formal.en: The doctor examined the boy's head.
formal.zh: 医生检查了男孩的头部。

colloquial.mt: — Għandek uġigħ ta' ras? — Iva, ftit.
colloquial.en: — Do you have a headache? — Yes, a little.
colloquial.zh: — 你头痛吗？— 是，有一点。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“头痛”的画面记 ras，再连读“ras it-tifel”。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个人或一头动物；个体计数单位

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività li wieħed jagħmel biex iwettaq kompitu jew jaqla' l-flus.

formal.en: The project created new work in the village.
formal.zh: 项目在村里创造了新的工作。

colloquial.en: — How is work going? — Well, thank you.
colloquial.zh: — 工作怎么样？— 很好，谢谢。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“新工作”的画面记 xogħol，再连读“post tax-xogħol”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min hu ħaj u l-esperjenzi tiegħu.

formal.en: The study examines quality of life.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察生活质量。

colloquial.en: — What is life like there? — Quiet.
colloquial.zh: — 那里的生活怎么样？— 很安静。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“长寿”的画面记 ħajja，再连读“kwalità tal-ħajja”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wiċċ solidu li nimxu fuqu jew biċċa minnu.

formal.en: This land is used for farming.

colloquial.en: — Where did the book fall? — On the floor.
colloquial.zh: — 书掉到哪里了？— 地上。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一块土地”的画面记 art，再连读“art agrikola”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ispazju li naraw fuqna meta nħarsu 'l fuq.

formal.en: The sky was clear throughout the day.

colloquial.mt: — Ħares lejn is-sema! — Kemm hu sabiħ!
colloquial.en: — Look at the sky! — How beautiful it is!
colloquial.zh: — 看天空！— 真美！

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“晴朗的天空”的画面记 sema，再连读“sema blu”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħana u dawl li joħorġu meta xi ħaġa tinħaraq.

formal.en: The fire destroyed part of the building.

colloquial.en: — Is there a fire? — Yes, call for help.
colloquial.zh: — 着火了吗？— 是，快求助。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大火”的画面记 nar，再连读“nar tal-injam”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arja li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor.

formal.en: The strong wind affected sea traffic.

colloquial.mt: — Hemm ħafna riħ? — Iva, ħu ġakketta.
colloquial.en: — Is it very windy? — Yes, take a jacket.
colloquial.zh: — 风大吗？— 是，带件外套。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“强风”的画面记 riħ，再连读“riħ kiesaħ”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qtar ta' ilma li jaqa' mis-sħab.

formal.en: The heavy rain caused flooding.

colloquial.mt: — Hemm ix-xita barra? — Iva, ħu umbrella.
colloquial.en: — Is it raining outside? — Yes, take an umbrella.
colloquial.zh: — 外面下雨吗？— 是，带把伞。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大雨”的画面记 xita，再连读“qatra xita”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġisem li jdur madwar id-Dinja u narawh fis-sema.

formal.en: The moon was clearly visible in the sky.
formal.zh: 月亮清晰地出现在天空中。

colloquial.en: — Can you see the moon? — Yes, up there.
colloquial.zh: — 你看见月亮了吗？— 是，在那上面。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“满月”的画面记 qamar，再连读“dawl il-qamar”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna żgħira ta' sess maskili.

formal.en: The boy started school this year.

colloquial.en: — Who is that boy? — My son.
colloquial.zh: — 那个男孩是谁？— 我儿子。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小男孩”的画面记 tifel，再连读“tifel tal-iskola”。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孩子；未指明性别的儿童

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna adulta ta' sess maskili.

formal.en: The man gave evidence in court.

colloquial.en: — Who came with you? — My husband.
colloquial.zh: — 谁跟你一起来的？— 我丈夫。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“高个子男人”的画面记 raġel，再连读“ir-raġel tiegħi”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna adulta ta' sess femminili.

formal.en: The woman submitted a new proposal.
formal.zh: 这名女子提交了新提案。

colloquial.mt: — Min hi dik il-mara? — Il-ġara tiegħi.
colloquial.en: — Who is that woman? — My neighbour.
colloquial.zh: — 那位女士是谁？— 我的邻居。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“年轻女子”的画面记 mara，再连读“il-mara tiegħi”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili li għandha ġenitur komuni miegħek.

formal.mt: Oħt il-pazjent kienet preżenti waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The patient's sister was present at the meeting.
formal.zh: 病人的姐妹出席了会议。

colloquial.en: — Do you have a sister? — Yes, one.
colloquial.zh: — 你有姐妹吗？— 是，有一个。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“妹妹”的画面记 oħt，再连读“oħt it-tifel”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li ħafna nies iżommu bħala sieħeb jew għall-għassa.

formal.en: The dog was found near the school.
formal.zh: 这只狗在学校附近被找到。

colloquial.en: — Whose dog is it? — Mine.
colloquial.zh: — 这是谁的狗？— 我的。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看门狗”的画面记 kelb，再连读“kelb żgħir”。

sense_translations.en_definition: cruel person, bastard, cunt, dick, dickhead

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir li jinżamm fid-djar u jaqbad il-ġrieden.

formal.en: The cat was found in the garden.
formal.zh: 这只猫在花园里被找到。

colloquial.en: — Where is the cat? — Under the table.
colloquial.zh: — 猫在哪里？— 在桌下。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“黑猫”的画面记 qattus，再连读“qattus żgħir”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal kbir li n-nies jistgħu jirkbuh.

formal.en: The horse won the race.

colloquial.en: — Do you want to see the horse? — Yes!
colloquial.zh: — 想看那匹马吗？— 想！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.en: Do you want to see the horse?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“白马”的画面记 żiemel，再连读“tiġrija taż-żwiemel”。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妓女；对女性的贬损称呼

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal bir-rix u l-ġwienaħ.

formal.en: The bird built a nest in the tree.

colloquial.en: — What is that? — A small bird.
colloquial.zh: — 那是什么？— 一只小鸟。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小鸟”的画面记 għasfur，再连读“għasfur tal-bejt”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta kbira b'zokk tal-injam u friegħi.

formal.en: The tree was planted near the school.

colloquial.en: — Where shall we rest? — Under the tree.
colloquial.zh: — 我们在哪里歇会儿？— 树下。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大树”的画面记 siġra，再连读“siġra taż-żebbuġ”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' pjanta li ħafna drabi jkollha kuluri u riħa.

formal.en: The flower was planted in the school garden.
formal.zh: 花种在了学校的花园里。

colloquial.en: — Would you like a flower? — Yes, that red one.
colloquial.zh: — 想要一朵花吗？— 想，要那朵红的。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“红花”的画面记 fjura，再连读“fjura sabiħa”。

sense_translations.zh_definition: fjur 的个体名词；一朵花

sense_translations.en_definition: a flower, blossom (reproductive structure on plants)

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' pjanta li fiha ż-żerriegħa u li ħafna drabi nieklu.

formal.en: Fresh fruit is sold at the market.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kellu l-ħila jew il-possibbiltà li jagħmel xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant seta' jagħżel bejn żewġ korsijiet.
formal.en: The participant could choose between two courses.
formal.zh: 参与者可以在两门课程中选择。

colloquial.en: — Could he come? — No, he was working.
colloquial.zh: — 他能来吗？— 不能，他当时在工作。

cognitive_memory_aid: seta' 是动词的词典引用形；用“seta' jaqra（能够阅读）”整组记。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies marbutin b'rabtiet ta' qrubija.

formal.en: The family received the necessary help.
formal.zh: 这个家庭得到了所需的帮助。

colloquial.mt: — Kif inhi l-familja? — Kulħadd tajjeb, grazzi.
colloquial.en: — How is the family? — Everyone is well, thank you.
colloquial.zh: — 家人都好吗？— 都好，谢谢。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大家庭”的画面记 familja，再连读“il-familja tiegħi”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rakkont ta' ġrajjiet jew l-istudju tal-passat.

formal.en: The book describes the history of the city.
formal.zh: 这本书描述了城市的历史。

colloquial.en: — Would you like to hear a story? — Yes!
colloquial.zh: — 想听个故事吗？— 想！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.en: Would you like to hear a story?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“马耳他的历史”的画面记 storja，再连读“storja qasira”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsejjes organizzati f'melodija jew ritmu.

formal.en: The school offers music lessons.

colloquial.en: — What music do you like? — Classical music.
colloquial.zh: — 你喜欢什么音乐？— 古典音乐。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“古典音乐”的画面记 mużika，再连读“mużika Maltija”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dinja tal-pjanti, l-annimali u l-ambjent ta' madwarna.

formal.en: The project promotes nature conservation.

colloquial.mt: — Tħobb in-natura? — Iva, inħobb nimxi fil-kampanja.
colloquial.en: — Do you like nature? — Yes, I like walking in the countryside.
colloquial.zh: — 你喜欢大自然吗？— 喜欢，我爱在乡间散步。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.en: Yes, I like walking in the countryside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“自然保护”的画面记 natura，再连读“imħabba għan-natura”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-drawwiet, l-arti u l-modi ta' ħajja ta' grupp ta' nies.

formal.en: The festival promotes Maltese culture.

colloquial.en: — Are you interested in Maltese culture? — Yes, very much.
colloquial.zh: — 你对马耳他文化感兴趣吗？— 是，很感兴趣。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你对马耳他文化感兴趣吗？
messages.en: Are you interested in Maltese culture?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“马耳他文化”的画面记 kultura，再连读“ċentru tal-kultura”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grupp ta' persuni li jmexxi pajjiż.

formal.en: The government announced new measures.

colloquial.en: — What did the government announce? — A new project.
colloquial.zh: — 政府宣布了什么？— 一个新项目。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“地方政府”的画面记 gvern，再连读“gvern ġdid”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola uffiċjali li trid tiġi osservata f'pajjiż.

formal.en: Parliament approved a new law.
formal.zh: 议会通过了一项新法律。

colloquial.mt: — Din liġi ġdida? — Iva, għadha kif għaddiet.
colloquial.en: — Is this a new law? — Yes, it has just passed.
colloquial.zh: — 这是新法律吗？— 是，刚刚通过。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“新法律”的画面记 liġi，再连读“skont il-liġi”。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat mingħajr gwerra jew ġlied.

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ naħat iffirmaw ftehim ta' paċi.
formal.en: The two sides signed a peace agreement.

colloquial.mt: — Trid ftit paċi? — Iva, għandi bżonn nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: — Do you want some peace and quiet? — Yes, I need to rest.
colloquial.zh: — 想清静一会儿吗？— 是，我需要休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.en: Do you want some peace and quiet?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“世界和平”的画面记 paċi，再连读“ftehim ta' paċi”。
